sources.title: Contrastive-LM releases open model for scoring AI agent actions
sources.snippet: Contrastive-LM has released CLM-8B, an open model that scores possible actions for an AI agent instead of generating text. It compares a description of the current situation with candidate actions, then returns probabilities that software can use to choose a tool or rank proposed solutions.
